approved_cipher_suites_enforced.title: Approved Cipher Suites Enforced
approved_cipher_suites_enforced.description: Indicates whether only approved/vetted cipher suites are explicitly configured and enforced for all remote sessions, preventing use of unapproved alternatives.

deprecated_algorithms_disabled.title: Deprecated Algorithms Disabled
deprecated_algorithms_disabled.description: Indicates whether known-weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms (e.g., RC4, DES, 3DES, MD5-based MACs, export-grade ciphers, SSLv2, SSLv3, TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1) are explicitly disabled.

minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version Enforced
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version accepted by the remote access service. Must be TLS 1.2 or higher to meet modern cryptographic standards.

legacy_protocols_disabled.title: Legacy/Insecure Protocols Explicitly Disabled
legacy_protocols_disabled.description: Whether insecure or legacy protocol variants (SSLv2, SSLv3, TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1, SSHv1) are explicitly disabled in the configuration.

ssh_protocol_version.title: SSH Protocol Version Enforced
ssh_protocol_version.description: The SSH protocol version enforced for remote shell access; SSHv1 is cryptographically broken and must be disabled.

mfa_enabled.title: MFA Enabled for Remote Sessions
mfa_enabled.description: Indicates whether multi-factor authentication is enforced for all remote access sessions.

mfa_enforcement_scope.title: MFA Enforcement Scope
mfa_enforcement_scope.description: Defines the scope of users and sessions subject to MFA enforcement for remote access.

mfa_bypass_methods_present.title: MFA Bypass Methods Present
mfa_bypass_methods_present.description: Indicates whether any legitimate bypass mechanisms (e.g., exception lists, fallback to password-only, trusted network exclusions) exist that allow remote sessions without MFA.

access_rules_defined.title: Access Rules Defined
access_rules_defined.description: Whether explicit access control rules are configured for remote connections, specifying permitted users, roles, devices, or source networks rather than relying on default allow-all behavior.

rule_specificity_level.title: Rule Specificity Level
rule_specificity_level.description: The granularity of access control rules — whether they target broad groups, role/group-level identities, or specific users and device identifiers combined with source network constraints.

default_deny_configured.title: Default Deny Policy Configured
default_deny_configured.description: Whether the remote access policy enforces an implicit or explicit default-deny posture, blocking any connection attempt not matched by an explicit allow rule.

source_network_restrictions_applied.title: Source Network Restrictions Applied
source_network_restrictions_applied.description: Whether access rules include source IP address or network range constraints that limit which networks or geographic locations can initiate remote connections.

idle_timeout_enabled.title: Idle Timeout Enabled
idle_timeout_enabled.description: Whether automatic session termination after a period of inactivity is enabled.

idle_timeout_seconds.title: Idle Timeout Duration (Seconds)
idle_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum number of seconds a session may remain idle before automatic termination.

max_session_duration_seconds.title: Maximum Session Duration (Seconds)
max_session_duration_seconds.description: Hard upper limit on total session lifetime regardless of activity; 0 means no limit enforced.

minimum_key_length_bits.title: Minimum Key Length (bits)
minimum_key_length_bits.description: The minimum cryptographic key length enforced for certificates and keys used in remote sessions (e.g., RSA 2048, ECC 256).

certificate_revocation_checking_enabled.title: Certificate Revocation Checking Enabled
certificate_revocation_checking_enabled.description: Whether CRL or OCSP revocation checking is enforced for certificates presented during remote session establishment.

key_rotation_period_days.title: Key Rotation Period (days)
key_rotation_period_days.description: Maximum number of days before cryptographic keys and certificates used for remote access must be rotated or renewed.

certificate_validity_enforcement.title: Certificate Validity Enforcement
certificate_validity_enforcement.description: Whether the remote access system enforces rejection of expired or not-yet-valid certificates during session establishment.

session_logging_enabled.title: Remote Session Logging Enabled
session_logging_enabled.description: Whether comprehensive logging of remote session events is enabled on the system or gateway.

logged_event_types.title: Logged Remote Session Event Types
logged_event_types.description: List of remote session event categories that are actively captured in logs (e.g., authentication_attempt, session_established, session_duration, session_terminated).

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days remote session logs are retained for forensic and compliance use.

remote_access_policy_documented.title: Remote Access Policy Formally Documented
remote_access_policy_documented.description: Indicates whether remote access rules and encryption protocols are captured in a formal, written policy document accessible to administrators and auditors.

policy_version_controlled.title: Policy Under Version Control
policy_version_controlled.description: Indicates whether the remote access policy is stored in a version-controlled system enabling change tracking and rollback.

policy_review_frequency_months.title: Policy Review Frequency (Months)
policy_review_frequency_months.description: The defined interval in months at which the remote access policy is reviewed and updated to reflect current controls and threats.
